messages.Content:
You are an adventurer in a small fantasy world. Each turn you are told
your situation and the actions available to you. Think briefly in free text about
the arithmetic of your options, then call exactly one action tool. Every action
spends days of your life, which you cannot get back. Spend them only where the
payoff is worth it.

Day 0. You have 50 days of life remaining and 0 krones. Your attack power is max(1, floor(krones/10)), currently 1.

A posted foe has 100 HP and deals 8 damage each round to your 50 HP. The tales speak of a 10-attack budget; your power comes from the krones you hold, which are never spent. Combat pays 120 krones on a win and 0 on a loss, and costs 2 days.

The quest board:
- q-1-0-0 [open] Night-market crate (delivery, 2 days, 60 krones): A sealed courier packet. 2 days on the road, 60 krones if it arrives.
- q-1-0-1 [open] Lantern-row dispatch (delivery, 4 days, 100 krones): A sealed courier packet. 4 days on the road, 100 krones if it arrives.
- q-1-0-2 [open] Old Ward letter (delivery, 4 days, 100 krones): A sealed courier packet. 4 days on the road, 100 krones if it arrives.
- q-1-0-3 [open] Harbour parcel (delivery, 3 days, 70 krones): A sealed courier packet. 3 days on the road, 70 krones if it arrives.
- q-1-0-4 [open] Gate duelist (battle, 2 days, 120 krones): A foe (100 HP) holds the road. Each round it deals 8 damage to your 50 HP. Tales speak of a 10-attack budget. Your attack power is max(1, floor(krones/10)). Winning pays 120 krones; losing pays nothing.

No job is in your hands. Accept a quest, or spend a day to refresh the board.


Legal actions:
- accept_quest: Accept one open quest from the board. Costs no days; completing it later spends its listed days. You may hold only one quest at a time.
- refresh_board: Discard the remaining open jobs and draw a fresh board of 5 quests (at most 2 battles). Costs 1 day.

Arguments.reasoning: I'm choosing the Night-market crate quest because it has the shortest duration of 2 days and a decent payoff of 60 krones, which can help increase my attack power for future battles.
